C1617.title: A Physics-Aware V2X Intrusion Detection System for Truck Platooning
C1617.summary: An open-source project implementing a physics-aware intrusion detection system for connected longitudinal truck platoons, leveraging V2V and V2I communications to detect false data injection attacks.
